title: グランドライブ再建計画、始動！

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: The Grand Concert used to be an annual performance organized by the students themselves, where every one of them got the chance to sing.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: But those days are long gone, and despite Light Hello's pleas to bring it back, the URA seems convinced that demand for a reboot simply isn't there.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Her vision—creating a space where all students can convey their gratitude through song—does find a sympathizer in Smart Falcon, who asks to help out.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: We decide to hold a promo concert to get the word out and hopefully attract supporters. The Grand Concert Reboot Project is officially underway!
